Fetch trip and pricing to calculate total const { data: trip } = await supabase.from("clnt_trips").select("*, pricing:clnt_trip_pricing(*)").eq("id", trip_id).single() if (!trip) throw new Error("Trip not found") const getPrice = (type: string) => trip.pricing.find((p: any) => p.service_type === type)?.price || 0 const total_amount = (count_passengers * getPrice('ADULT')) + // Simplified: assuming all are adults for manual entry or need adding CHILD field (count_bikes * getPrice('BIKE')) // 2. Send Cancellation Email (via Supabase Edge Function) if (email) { // We do this before deletion to ensure we have the data, or we can assume it works. // Proceeding with deletion even if email fails is usually better for admin consistency, // but we should log it. try { await supabase.functions.invoke('resend-email', { body: { recipients: [email], subject: 'Reservation Cancelled - Zalew Wiślany', html: `

Reservation Cancelled

Your reservation (ID: ${id.slice(0, 8)}) has been cancelled by the administrator.

If you have any questions, please contact us.

` } }) } catch (e) { console.error("Failed to send cancellation email", e) } } // 2. Get current reservation to find trip_id (to get pricing) const { data: currentRes, error: fetchError } = await supabase .from("clnt_reservations") .select("trip_id") .eq("id", id) .single() if (fetchError || !currentRes) throw new Error("Reservation not found") // 2. Fetch trip pricing const { data: trip } = await supabase .from("clnt_trips") .select("pricing:clnt_trip_pricing(*)") .eq("id", currentRes.trip_id) .single() if (!trip) throw new Error("Trip not found") const getPrice = (type: string) => trip.pricing.find((p: any) => p.service_type === type)?.price || 0 const new_total = (count_passengers * getPrice('ADULT')) + (count_bikes * getPrice('BIKE')) // 3. Update const { error } = await supabase.from("clnt_reservations").update({ status, customer_email, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, phone_number, notes, count_passengers, count_bikes, total_amount: new_total }).eq("id", id) if (error) throw new Error(error.message) revalidatePath("/admin/reservations") return { success: true } } 'use client' import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/dialog" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select" import { createReservation } from "./actions" import { useState } from "react" import { Plus } from "lucide-react" export function CreateReservationDialog({ trips }: { trips: any[] }) { const [open, setOpen] = useState(false) async function handleSubmit(formData: FormData) { await createReservation(formData) setOpen(false) } return ( Create Reservation Manually create a reservation for a customer.
